result:
All 14 queries ran against the data files and gave plausible answers. I didn't check every answer by hand beyond a few spot checks (the U2 total, the U9 averages).

- **U7:** the average GET duration came out as `94`.
- **U9:** a map printed in qlang's own notation, not JSON.
- **U13:** the tag match doesn't trim whitespace around the tags. The sample lines didn't need it.

U1: /data/users | filter ~(at :active | eq true) | filter ~(at :address | at :city | ne null) | filter ~(/address/city | lower | eq "berlin") | sort ~(/name | lower) | map ~(/name)
U2: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | map ~(at :items | coalesce [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
U3: filter ~(at :items | coalesce [] | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/customer) | map ~(count)
U4: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
U5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(/assignee | ne null) | groupBy ~(/assignee/login) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:assignee (/0 | keyword) :count /1}) | sort ~([(/count | desc) /assignee]) | take 3
U6: map ~(at :labels | coalesce [] | map ~(lower)) | flat | distinct | sort
U7: lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | map ~(/4 | take (count | sub 2) | parseJson) | avg | round 1
U8: lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | map ~(count) | entries | map ~({:p (/0 | keyword) :c /1}) | sort ~([(/c | desc) /p]) | take 2 | map ~(/p)
U9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split "," | {:name /0 :cat (/1 | lower) :price /2 :stock /3}) | filter ~(/price | ne "") | map ~({:name /name :cat /cat :price (/price | parseJson) :stock (/stock | parseJson)}) | groupBy ~(/cat) | map ~(map ~(/price) | avg | round 2)
U10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split "," | {:name /0 :price (/2) :stock (/3 | parseJson)}) | filter ~(/price | ne "") | filter ~(/stock | ne 0) | map ~({:name /name :price (/price | parseJson)}) | sort ~([(/price | desc) /name]) | take 3 | map ~(/name)
U11: :d /defaults | /services | entries | map ~({:name (/0 | keyword) :v /1}) | filter ~(/v | at :enabled | ne false) | map ~({:name /name :port (/v | at :port | coalesce (d | /port))}) | sort ~(/name)
U12: sort ~(/ts) | reverse | groupBy ~(/user) | map ~(first | /type)
U13: lines | map ~(trim) | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | eq false) | map ~(split "|" | map ~(trim)) | filter ~(/2 | lower | split "," | contains "prod") | map ~(/0 | upper) | sort | join ","
U14: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","fig","Elderberry","cherry","Fig"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | :w / | {:count count :longest (w | sort ~([(count | desc) /]) | take 2)}
